about_short_description.short_description: Beeper allows users to chat across multiple platforms, simplifying the messaging experience.

product.name: Beeper Universal Chat App
product.description: A single application that consolidates messaging from over 10 different chat networks into one interface, syncing messages across devices.

product.name: Beeper Mini
product.description: A privacy-focused chat client that connects directly to third-party chat services without relying on Beeper’s cloud infrastructure, storing data locally with end-to-end encryption.

product.name: Beeper Cloud
product.description: A cloud-based service that stores encrypted message contents and attachments with end-to-end encryption, enabling message synchronization across devices.

product.name: Beeper unified messaging app
product.description: A unified messaging app update adding Line integration, Raycast support, stickers, UI tweaks, and improved iMessage features.
